1133bc568028.en: Is I-Cost construction project management software?

2be04fab6031.en: Yes, for the commercial side of construction projects: estimating, client quotations, supplier management, purchase orders, deliveries, timesheets, the programme, cost tracking and carbon. It does not replace drawing management, RFI or snagging tools.

1c00efa29a57.en: Is I-Cost suitable for small construction businesses?

a7cccf030d97.en: Yes. You pay £35 per user per month with no set-up fee, so a team of two costs £70 a month, and you can start with a 7-day free trial on one live project.

4883ce92fbdf.en: Does it replace Microsoft Project or other planning tools?

b73238eefd62.en: I-Cost includes a simple programme (Gantt chart) built from the estimate, with dates, progress and late work flagged. For detailed critical-path scheduling you may still want a dedicated planning tool.

d2e8653f5413.en: Can site teams use it on their phones?

ffdba229b8f2.en: Yes. I-Cost runs in the browser and installs like an app on phone, tablet and PC. Site teams log hours and confirm deliveries from their phone.

17e6257aaf16.en: How long does it take to get started?

2a577047cdca.en: You can sign up, import a BOQ, invite your team and send your first quotation request on the first day, with a guided tutorial showing each step on the real screens.
